title: Check Balanced String
summary: Given a string of digits, determine if the sum of digits at even indices equals the sum of digits at odd indices.
statement: Given a string of digits, determine if the sum of digits at even indices equals the sum of digits at odd indices. Return true if balanced, otherwise false.
constraints: A digit string is balanced when digits at even indices and odd indices have equal sums.
Return whether the two sums match.
reference_solution:
def is_balanced_digit_string(num):
    even=sum(int(num[i]) for i in range(0,len(num),2))
    odd=sum(int(num[i]) for i in range(1,len(num),2))
    return even==odd
